source.tool: Ultimate Fantasy RTS pack (glTF/ folder of the downloaded archive)
source.license_notice: License_Source.txt (copied with CRLF normalized to LF; the pack's notice names it 'Ultimate Platformer Pack' by mistake, the licence is CC0 1.0)

references: packages/client/public/house-lab/kit/T_WoodTrim_{BaseColor,Normal,Roughness}.png (Quaternius Medieval Village MegaKit, CC0; see house-lab/kit/abom.json)

transforms: planks: scripts/port-kit/derive_planks.py crops rows 0..312 (Light) and 328..640 (Dark) of each T_WoodTrim map at full width, pixels unchanged
scale: uniform x7.5 on every RTS model (pack-wide RPG scale; RTS house door 0.285 u -> 2.14 m)
weld: remove_doubles 0.002 m (the RTS meshes ship one island per face)

pier: Dock_FirstAge split into Pier_Deck_2m (middle bay y -1..1), Pier_Posts (pile pair at y -1.565) and Pier_End (last 0.6 m); cut ends capped; narrowed from 3.78 m to 2.08 m wide: pieces long across the deck scale in x, piles/stringers/caps keep their section and move inward
boat: hull island of Port_FirstAge_Level2 aligned to its principal axis, scaled x0.7 (6.5 x 3 m -> 4.5 x 2.1 m)
hut/barrel/sacks: islands of Port_FirstAge_Level1 selected by bounds, recentred, floor at 0
materials: Wood -> GU_WoodPlankDark, Wood_Light -> GU_WoodPlankLight (plank textures); Fabric and Metal_Light keep their RTS colour, roughness 0.85 (metal metallic 0.6); one material per name
uv: per-face planar projection, 0.5 repeats/m along the grain and 1/0.61 across; grain follows the longest axis of each connected piece
export: Blender 5.2.2 glTF exporter (Khronos glTF Blender I/O), GLTF_SEPARATE, no tangents
